recipes.name: Roasted Sweet Potato & Kale Salad
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F / 220°C*. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the roasted sweet potato ingredients on the sheet and toss to coat.
Bake until the potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes, stirring halfway through. When the garlic is cool enough to handle, peel them and save for the dressing. Let the sweet potatoes cool slightly.
In a medium bowl, combine the lemon juice, mint, olive oil, vinegar, maple syrup, onion powder, and salt. Mash the roasted garlic cloves and mix them into the dressing.
In a large bowl, drizzle the olive oil over the kale and massage the leaves with your hands for 1 to 2 minutes, until softened**.
Add the sweet potatoes to the bowl along with the chickpeas, avocado, and dressing. Toss everything to combine.
Top with the roasted almonds and serve. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † For us, 3 medium sweet potatoes weighed 1 lb 5 oz / 600g total. † From about 1 large bunch curly kale. † One (15 oz / 425g) can yields about 1½ cups when drained. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** Massaging the kale breaks down its toughness and reduces bitterness. Just 1 minute with a drizzle of olive oil does the trick.

Storage Best if enjoyed immediately. Store the salad separately from the dressing in airtight container s in the fridge for up to 3 days. Ideally, add the avocado only when ready to enjoy to avoid browning.
